name: open-sharia-enterprise
description: Open source platform for researching and building trustworthy, Sharia-compliant enterprise products.

scripts.organiclever:dev: ./hippo run --class service --disk-path . -- docker compose --env-file infra/dev/organiclever-app/.env -f infra/dev/organiclever-app/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.organiclever:dev:restart: npm run organiclever:dev:reset && npm run organiclever:dev --
scripts.dev:ose-www: ./hippo run --class service --disk-path . -- docker compose -f infra/dev/ose-www/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.dev:organiclever: ./hippo run --class service --disk-path . -- docker compose --env-file infra/dev/organiclever-app/.env -f infra/dev/organiclever-app/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.generate:bindings: ./hippo run --class transactional --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness bindings generate
scripts.sync:agents: ./hippo run --class transactional --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness bindings generate --harness opencode
scripts.sync:skills: ./hippo run --class transactional --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness bindings generate --harness opencode
scripts.sync:dry-run: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness bindings generate --harness opencode --dry-run
scripts.validate:sync: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness sync validate
scripts.validate:claude: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness claude validate
scripts.validate:config: npm run validate:claude && npm run generate:bindings && npm run validate:opencode
scripts.harness:bindings-validation: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --disk-path . -- dotnet run --project apps/rhino-cli/src/RhinoCli.Program/RhinoCli.Program.fsproj -- harness bindings validate
scripts.organiclever:dev:reset: ./hippo run --class transactional --disk-path . -- docker compose --env-file infra/dev/organiclever-app/.env -f infra/dev/organiclever-app/docker-compose.yml down -v

**/Dockerfile*: sh -ec 'for f; do [ ! -e "$f" ] || hadolint --failure-threshold warning "$f"; done' --
docker-compose*.{yml,yaml}: bash -c 'set -e; for f; do base=${f%.ci.yml}.yml; if [ "$base" != "$f" ] && [ -f "$base" ]; then docker compose -f "$base" -f "$f" config > /dev/null; else docker compose -f "$f" config > /dev/null; fi; done' --
